async-method invocation node emitted at the method definition site (class Benchmark.runIteration): its callee is the async-function continuation inside the method, not a separately addressable closure target, so no call/closure guard can be attached.
immediately-invoked async function expression: the callee is the in-place function expression itself (not a nameable separate closure target whose range could be attached to a call guard).
